title: Perpendicularity and Locality for Codimension-One Varifolds with Bounded Anisotropic Mean Curvature
summary: Suppose $ F $ is an integrand associated with a uniformly convex $ \mathscr{C}^{3} $-norm, and $ V $ is a $ n $-dimensional varifold in an open subset of $ \mathbf{R}^{n+1} $ such that $ \mathscr{H}^n \llcorner \operatorname{spt} \| V \| $ is absolutely continuous with respect to $ \| V \| $ and the mean $ F $-curvature $ \mathbf{h}_{F}(V, \cdot) $ is bounded in $\mathbf{L}^\infty $. In our previous result arXiv:2507.18357 we prove that $ \operatorname{spt} \| V \| $ is $ \mathscr{C}^{2} $-rectifiable and the $ \mathscr{C}^{1} $-regular part $ M $ of $ \operatorname{spt} \| V \| $ coincides…
